2607.26642.title: AlphaSchema: Exploring the Space of Trading Semantics for LLM-Based Alpha Mining
2607.26642.paper_summary: Automated alpha mining has increasingly adopted large language model (LLM) agents for factor generation and iterative discovery. However, existing LLM-based systems often delegate both factor construction and search decisions to the agent itself, without an explicit exploration space or a principled mechanism for navigating that space. As a result, exploration remains largely implicit and difficult to control or optimize systematically. We introduce AlphaSchema, which constructs and explores a structured space of trading semantics for alpha mining. Each point in this space is a schema plan composed of Event, Context, Qualities, Direction, and Output, specifying the semantics of a candidate factor before implementation. AlphaSchema decouples exploration from implementation: an LLM translates selected schema plans into executable factors, while evaluated rewards are accumulated to learn a surrogate model over the semantic space. An iterative selection mechanism uses this model to balance global exploration, surrogate-guided exploitation, and local mutation. Experiments on the Chinese stock market show that AlphaSchema discovers factor pools with strong predictive and portfolio performance. Further analyses show that the semantic search process navigates diverse regions while increasingly allocating evaluations toward high-reward regions, and that implementations of the same schema plans by different LLMs exhibit comparable predictive quality, suggesting that alpha mining quality is largely robust to the choice of LLM within our framework.
2607.26642.paper_summary_zh: 自動化的 alpha 採礦越來越多地採用大型語言模型 (LLM) 代理來生成因子和進行迭代發現。<lb/>然而，現有的基於 LLM 的系統通常將因子構建和搜索決策委託給代理本身，沒有明確的探索空間或導航該空間的原則機制。<lb/>因此，探索在很大程度上仍然是隱性的，難以系統地控制或優化。<lb/>我們介紹了 AlphaSchema，它構建並探索一個結構化的交易語義空間以進行 alpha 採礦。<lb/>這個空間中的每一點都是一個由事件、上下文、特質、方向和輸出組成的架構計劃，指定了候選因子在實施前的語義。<lb/>AlphaSchema 將探索與實施解耦：LLM 將選定的架構計劃轉換為可執行的因子，同時評估的獎勵被累積以學習語義空間上的替代模型。<lb/>一個迭代選擇機制利用這個模型來平衡全局探索、替代引導的開發和局部變異。<lb/>在中國股市的實驗表明，AlphaSchema 發現了具有強大預測和投資組合表現的因子池。<lb/>進一步分析顯示，語義搜索過程在不同區域中導航，同時越來越多地將評估分配到高獎勵區域，而不同 LLM 對相同架構計劃的實施表現出可比的預測質量，這表明在我們的框架內，alpha 採礦的質量在很大程度上對 LLM 的選擇是穩健的。
